Does the participants data dictionary match the c04-olos code?

Long image

A

Answer

Yes, with five fixes. No column's status is wrong, and every line the dictionary cites says what it claims. It misses three writers, gives one wrong example, and states one claim too broadly.

  1. A cycle-interest API can write five profile columns, but no page in the repo calls it.1
  2. Placeholder ("stub") rows came from the Energy and Health pod registration sheets, not problem statement submissions.2
  3. An owner-only database function can change email, which leaves google_id holding the old address.3
  4. Two test scripts write google_id values that are not email addresses.4

Applies toc04-olos main at ca543cc (clean checkout)participants-data-dictionary.md built 2026-11-19writers checked by listing every insert, update and delete on participantsreaders checked by column-name search

1

What writes to the participants table?

Diagram structure
  • Sign-up API signup
  • Profile edit API profile
  • Cycle interest API interest
  • Pod, admin, sign-in, self-service other
  • Email change function emailfn
  • Legacy import legacy
  • Test scripts tests
  • participants table db
  • signup → db · new row
  • profile → db · profile fields
  • interest → db · 5 fields
  • other → db · single fields
  • emailfn → db · email
  • legacy → db · legacy rows
  • tests → db · fake rows
  1. Sign-up API ↗

    Creates every current row. Matches the dictionary, including is_test, photo_video_consent = true and no created_via.

  2. Cycle interest API ↗

    Missing from the dictionary. Writes state, work_situation, main_focus, sector and linkedin. No page calls it.

  3. Email change function ↗

    Missing from the dictionary. Owner or server code only; the caller is an edge function outside this repo.

  4. Test scripts ↗

    Write google_id values such as seed-test-c4-p0, not emails.

  5. Pod, admin, sign-in, self-service ↗

    Pod leader edit, staff and tester flags, sign-in link, avatar, pulse check, lab join, follow seeding, archive and ban. All match the dictionary.

state, work_situation, main_focus, sector, linkedinWritten by the legacy import and profile editor (and sign-up for work_situation)POST /api/cycles/[cycle_id]/interest also updates all five; the API inventory notes no in-repo callerGapAdd it as a dormant writer
notes stub rowsStubs for people in other sheets, "for example, problem statement submissions"Stubs come only from Energy and Health Pod Registration sheets; the problem statement pass inserts no participantsWrongReplace the example
emailWritten by the sign-up form and legacy importchange_participant_email() also writes it; a trigger blocks every other email changeGapAdd the function and the guard
google_id"An email address, from every writer"True for the app and the import; two test scripts write other values, and the API stores whatever the client sendsToo broadSay "every app writer"
last_pulse_completed_at, metro_idWritten by pulse check, sign-up and lab joinMigrations 00010 and 00044 also backfilled existing rows onceGapOptional note

The interest API validates state as any string up to 100 characters. The database CHECK still limits it to MD, DC, VA or Other, so bad values would fail at insert.

Legacy-only columns

App write calls
17 calls in 15 files; none writes a column the dictionary calls orphaned

Limits of this check

Readers were found by searching for column names. The profile page selects every column but shows only profile fields. Edge functions that call the database live outside this repo, so their writes are not covered.
